case: Computed abs() results preserve native runtime storage classes through typed CSV
contract: The native typeof() oracle covers negative INTEGER and REAL values, numeric and nonnumeric TEXT, empty TEXT, numeric and nonnumeric BLOB, SQL NULL, and the i64::MIN boundary.
abs() retains INTEGER for integer input, REAL for real/text/blob input, and NULL for SQL NULL; SQLite refuses abs(i64::MIN) with integer overflow.
BookiE's typed CSV encoding is restored into another STRICT ANY table; persisted native typeof() and values match the computed result for every non-overflowing input.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib ui::browse_tab::value_parse::sqlite_any_contract::sqlite_abs_any_csv_round_trip_preserves_runtime_storage_classes -- --exact --test-threads=1

app_library_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings
